capabilities: Embed HTML files in notes with ![[file.html]] syntax
Embed remote web pages by their address
Resize embeds with width, height, auto-fit or CSS declarations
Scroll to or extract a specific element by id
Open embeds in their own tab or an external browser
disambiguation: It embeds whole HTML files and web pages in notes, not inline HTML written inside Markdown.
extras: The README itself is an interactive demo vault that ships with each release; beta versions install via BRAT. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian embeds notes, images and PDFs, but an .html file in a vault can only be opened as a file, not shown inside a note.

relations.evidence: Ensure you have the BRAT plugin installed and enabled.

summary: Embeds HTML files and web pages inside notes using native embed syntax, with sizing, element extraction and theme styling.
